description: This file contains implementation of Orleans grains for testing request context propagation, including classes for request context testing, task-based request context handling, and proxy grains, with methods for echoing trace IDs, logging, and managing activity IDs.

classes.name: RequestContextTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain that provides methods to echo and retrieve trace IDs and activity IDs, demonstrating request context propagation.

classes.name: RequestContextTaskGrain
classes.description: A grain that performs request context operations with detailed logging, including delayed and asynchronous echo methods.

classes.name: RequestContextProxyGrain
classes.description: A proxy grain that delegates activity ID retrieval to another test grain.

methods.name: TraceIdEcho
methods.description: Returns the current request's TraceId from the RequestContext.

methods.name: TraceIdDoubleEcho
methods.description: Creates a new grain instance and calls its TraceIdEcho method.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho1
methods.description: Returns the TraceId asynchronously using Task.Factory.StartNew.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEcho2
methods.description: Returns the TraceId asynchronously using ContinueWith.

methods.name: TraceIdDelayedEchoAwait
methods.description: Returns the TraceId after awaiting a continuation task.

methods.name: E2EActivityId
methods.description: Returns the current request's activity ID (ReentrancyId).

methods.name: TestRequestContext
methods.description: Sets a value in the request context and retrieves it from multiple tasks, demonstrating context propagation.
